# Sweepr Status

> Live uptime and incident history for Sweepr, a home-cleaning marketplace
> operated by ClearKey Solutions, LLC. Use this page to check current system
> status or look up past incidents.

## Key pages

- [Status](https://status.getsweepr.com/): Current uptime and incident history.
- [Sweepr marketing site](https://getsweepr.com/): Book a cleaning, see pricing and FAQ.
